== Ingredients ==
* 1½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] sliced [[Cookbook:Button Mushroom|button mushrooms]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* 4 [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. (24–32 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]]) New York strip [[Cookbook:Beef|steaks]], trimmed of excess fat
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* Freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]]
* [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|Olive oil]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] freshly-[[Cookbook:Mince|minced]] [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]]
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]] [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]]

== Procedure ==
#[[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] steak with olive oil. Season liberally on both sides with salt and freshly ground black pepper.
#Preheat [[Cookbook:Grill|grill]]. Add steaks and cook 4–5 minutes per side for medium rare, rotating 90 degrees halfway to create grill marks.
#While steak is grilling, prepare mushrooms. Melt butter in a large straight-sided [[Cookbook:Sauté Pan|sauté pan]] over medium high heat. Add garlic and keep it moving until golden. Add onion and mushrooms and cook, [[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|tossing]] occasionally, until mushrooms are as browned as you like.
#Serve steaks with sautéed mushrooms and desired sides.

steps.text: Brush steak with olive oil. Season liberally on both sides with salt and freshly ground black pepper.
Preheat grill. Add steaks and cook 4–5 minutes per side for medium rare, rotating 90 degrees halfway to create grill marks.

While steak is grilling, prepare mushrooms. Melt butter in a large straight-sided sauté pan over medium high heat. Add garlic and keep it moving until golden. Add onion and mushrooms and cook, tossing occasionally, until mushrooms are as browned as you like.
Serve steaks with sautéed mushrooms and desired sides.
